body.p: Earlier the black grouse had no name. Once the black grouse and the owl went to God, they were about to complain about each other. They came to God, they began to complain about each other; the black grouse said: "The owl always catches me." The owl said: "I never catch the black grouse, the black grouse is caught by the black grouse-hawk(?)." The black grouse was heavily ashamed, it fell into the snow, until(?) it was covered by snow. Therefore it now has started to crawl in the snow. God said: "Wild black grouse." So his name became "black grouse".
